scope: Prebuilt library of admitted app definitions for the ADR-011 pitch; synthetic data, no customer evidence. Router metadata only: nothing here is a grant, a query result or an admission verdict.

apps.title: Expense review queue
apps.purpose: Review submitted expense claims: the queue, the totals and spend by category, with a decision form.

routing.description: Expense claim review queue with totals, spend by category and a decision form over the organization's submitted claims.

apps.title: Vendor spend breakdown
apps.purpose: Spend by vendor and category from issued invoices, the unpaid invoices by due date, and a decision form.

routing.description: Vendor spend breakdown: invoice totals, the top vendors and categories, and unpaid invoices ordered by due date.
intent_examples: who are we paying the most

apps.title: Outbound traffic investigation
apps.purpose: Northstar's Security case: outbound bytes by destination and hour for the organization's assets, the largest transfers, and an observation form.

routing.description: Outbound network traffic investigation: total bytes, bytes by destination and per hour, and the largest transfers for an asset and window.
intent_examples: which destinations received the most bytes

apps.title: Incident timeline
apps.purpose: Incidents opened per day, by severity and service, the ones still open, and a review form.

routing.description: Incident timeline: incidents opened per day, counts by severity, the open ones, and resolution-time extremes.

apps.title: Access review tracker
apps.purpose: Pending access requests by system and level, admin requests to scrutinize, and an approval decision form.

routing.description: Access review tracker: pending access requests, requests by system and status, admin-level requests, with an approval decision form.

apps.title: Sales pipeline by stage
apps.purpose: Pipeline value and deal count by stage and owner, the largest open deals, and a review form.

routing.description: Sales pipeline by stage and owner: deal counts, pipeline value, the largest deals in negotiation and the totals.

apps.title: Inventory comparison
apps.purpose: Units on hand by warehouse and product, the low-stock SKUs, and a reorder decision form.

routing.description: Inventory comparison across warehouses: units on hand by warehouse and product, SKUs below a stock threshold and the totals.

apps.title: Support ticket queue
apps.purpose: Open tickets by priority, tickets per day and channel, first-response times, and a triage decision form.

routing.description: Support ticket queue: open tickets by priority, tickets by channel and per day, and first-response extremes.
intent_examples: how many tickets came in today

apps.title: Budget vs actual
apps.purpose: Budget and actual spend by department and month, the totals, and a variance review form.

routing.description: Budget versus actual spend by department and month with totals and a variance review form.

apps.title: Audit trail viewer
apps.purpose: Recent audit events, events by action and outcome, denied actions, and a review form.

routing.description: Audit trail viewer: recent audit events, counts by action, denied actions and events per hour.

apps.title: Cash-flow statement
apps.purpose: Money in and money out from the statement, the daily cash-flow timeline, recent activity, and a reconciliation note form.

routing.description: Cash-flow statement from bank transactions: money in versus money out, a daily timeline, recent activity and the largest payments.

apps.title: Hiring funnel
apps.purpose: Candidates by stage, role and source, the recent applicants, and a screening decision form.

routing.description: Hiring funnel: candidates by stage, source and role, and the most recent applicants.
intent_examples: how many candidates are at onsite

apps.title: Subscription revenue
apps.purpose: Monthly recurring revenue by plan and status, the active subscriptions, the top customers, and a review form.

routing.description: Subscription revenue: MRR by plan and status, active MRR and the top customers by recurring revenue.
intent_examples: how much recurring revenue is active

apps.title: Expense claims
apps.purpose: File an expense in your own words, send it to your manager for approval, and watch the decision land live: every claim is a typed record, every decision an audited command.

routing.description: Expense claims with manager approval: file a claim (amount, merchant, category, date, note), share it with an approver, approve or reject it; the claims list updates live.
intent_examples: I spent $86 on a client dinner at Nobu, Sarah approves my expenses
submit a reimbursement for my flight
what is waiting for my approval

apps.title: Time off
apps.purpose: Request time off in your own words; your manager approves or rejects it, and the team sees who is out.

routing.description: Time off requests with manager approval: request vacation, sick or personal days (dates, days, note), the manager approves or rejects, and the team sees upcoming time off and days taken.
intent_examples: I need a day off next Friday
who is out of office next week
Book me off Nov 24-26 for Thanksgiving

apps.title: Purchase requests
apps.purpose: Ask to buy something; your manager approves it, and anything over $5,000 also needs finance. Both steps are declared rules the server enforces.

routing.description: Purchase requests with multi-level approval: request an item from a vendor with an amount and cost center; the manager approves, and requests over $5,000 also need finance.
intent_examples: buy new laptops for the team
I need to purchase software licenses

apps.title: Vendor invoices
apps.purpose: Log a supplier invoice, approve it for payment and mark it paid or disputed; the server checks the PO against your purchase requests.

routing.description: Vendor invoices (accounts payable approval): log a supplier invoice with its number, amount, PO and due date, approve it for payment, mark it paid or disputed; a PO match flag against purchase requests.
intent_examples: log an invoice from a supplier
match an invoice to a purchase order

views.title: Invoices that do not match their PO

apps.title: Access requests
apps.purpose: Ask for access to a system with a role, a reason and an end date; the system owner grants or denies it, and grants expire.

routing.description: Access requests: ask for access to a system with a role, reason and expiry date; the system owner grants or denies; grants expiring this month.
intent_examples: I need admin access to the production database
give me write access to payroll until Friday
temporary access until the end of the month

apps.title: Deal desk
apps.purpose: Ask for a discount on a deal; up to 10% approves itself by a declared rule, deeper discounts go to the sales manager.

routing.description: Deal desk discount approvals: request a discount percent on a deal for an account with a reason; up to 10% approves automatically, deeper discounts go to the sales manager.
intent_examples: request a 15% discount for Kestrel Logistics
approve the discount on the Brightwater deal

apps.title: Notes
apps.purpose: Quick notes: type /note and a sentence to keep a note as a card on your canvas; each note is a typed record of your own.

routing.description: Quick personal notes: write a short note with a title and a body and keep it as a card on the canvas.
intent_examples: remember to call the auditor Friday
